_comment: Replaces the branch-shared models/item/experience_bucket.json, which uses the `neoforge:fluid_container`
MODEL LOADER. That loader is gone by this band, and a model asking for one is a hard JSON parse
failure rather than a missing texture, so leaving the shared file to be found here breaks the client
A plain empty bucket, matching what the other nodes fall back to. It is only reached if the
client-item JSON beside it is missing, and an empty bucket then reads as 'something is wrong with
this item' rather than as a different fluid.
